India fall short in 2-3 defeat against Netherlands in FIH Hockey Men’s Pro League
The Indian Men's Hockey Team suffered a narrow 2-3 loss against the Netherlands in their opening match of the Rotterdam leg of FIH Pro League on Sunday. Dilpreet Singh and Sukhjeet Singh scored for India, while Miles Bukkens, Koen Bijen and Tijmen Reyenga found the back of the net for the Dutch.
